format.title: Output format
format.description: Reuse originals or convert data with explicit biological metadata. HIC/Cooler require raw counts and genomic bins; GenBank preserves annotated records or writes DNA sequences.

filename.title: Filename stem
filename.description: Optional basename without extension. Leave empty to reuse same-task original files without copying.

include_labels.title: Include table labels
include_labels.description: CSV/TSV header and row labels. NPY preserves array dtype and shape; labels remain in the workflow data.

buffer_mb.title: Write buffer (MiB)
buffer_mb.description: Bounded NPY/contact I/O buffer. Native compression and bin metadata also use the execution memory budget.

resolution.title: Contact resolution (bp)
resolution.description: Optional override; must match source bins. Required for multi-resolution Cooler.

chrom_sizes.title: Chromosome sizes
chrom_sizes.description: Full chromosome lengths; usually supplied by the contact source. Never inferred from a window.

topology.title: DNA topology
topology.description: For sequence-only GenBank export. Preserved GenBank records keep their original topology.
